title: Not Impressed
text: Not Impressed. First and foremost a towel has to dry, dishes, hands, the counter. These are pretty lousy at any of those things. Even when there's a spill of water on the countertop I find I have to press these towels, they were washed twice before using, into the spill otherwise it would just push the water around the counter. My hands never feel dry no matter how long I try. They're cute, the design is attractively retro but I'm going to have to replace them because they're not much good at being a towel.
